_comment: Per-skill install catalog for the /jarvis-setup page. One entry per skill the plugin can install individually (replaces the old core/research/media category toggles). Every license/author claim here was checked against a primary source (a local LICENSE file, or upstream raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/<branch>/LICENSE) -- never a README claim or blog post. See setup/server.mjs's report-back for the exact sources read. `id` must match the skill's directory name under skills/ (or optional-skills/ when disabled).

skills.name: Session Wrap-Up (done)
skills.description: Saves what happened, so nothing is lost
skills.author: jarvis-os project
skills.details: Writes a session note, folds it into hub memory, and commits the hub -- run this at the end of every session.

skills.name: Memory Consolidation
skills.description: Turns recent sessions into lasting memory
skills.author: jarvis-os project
skills.details: Folds recent session logs into the hub's memory files so patterns and decisions persist.

skills.name: Wiki Article
skills.description: Keeps what you figured out as a short note
skills.author: jarvis-os project
skills.details: Turns a discovery or research session into a short reference article instead of losing it to scrollback.

skills.name: Grill Me
skills.description: Questions your plan until it holds up
skills.author: jarvis-os project
skills.details: Interviews you about a plan or design until every branch of the decision actually holds together.

skills.name: Learn
skills.description: Keeps takeaways from books and courses
skills.author: jarvis-os project
skills.details: Captures book, course, or article takeaways into a structured, dated personal learning log.

skills.name: ELI5 Visual Explainer
skills.description: Explains with pictures instead of walls of text
skills.author: jarvis-os project
skills.note: The instructions are original, not copied from a licensed repo -- no matching skill exists in kepano/obsidian-skills or anthropics/skills (both checked). The file itself credits the underlying prompting pattern to Thariq (Anthropic) via a public tweet and https://leslieli.dev/notes/anthropic-eli5-skill-html-artifacts/ -- that's an idea credit, not a license grant, since no redistributable source file was found to vendor from.
skills.details: Explains a concept or codebase as a visual, big-picture HTML artifact instead of a wall of text.

skills.name: Defuddle
skills.description: Turns a web page into clean, readable text
skills.author: Steph Ango (@kepano)
skills.note: Vendored byte-identical to upstream (diff against raw.githubusercontent.com/kepano/obsidian-skills/main/skills/defuddle/SKILL.md is empty).
skills.details: Strips a web page down to clean markdown locally, before you read or summarize it.

skills.name: QMD
skills.author: Tobi Lutke
skills.note: Bundled copy is a hand-trimmed fork of upstream v2.0.0; current upstream is v2.2.0 and has since added --full-path, line-slicing, and `qmd doctor` that this copy doesn't have.
skills.details: Local hybrid search (keyword + embeddings) over your own markdown notes.

skills.name: Research Notebook
skills.description: Researches a topic and cites its sources
skills.author: jarvis-os project
skills.note: Needs the separate `notebooklm` CLI installed and authenticated with a Google account -- not bundled, no API key involved.
skills.details: Drives NotebookLM to ingest sources, ask questions, and return a cited research synthesis.

skills.name: Media Gen
skills.description: Makes images and video from a description
skills.author: jarvis-os project
skills.details: Photoreal image and video generation and upscaling via fal.ai, pay-per-use.

skills.name: Playwright CLI
skills.description: Checks a website and takes screenshots
skills.author: jarvis-os project
skills.note: Bundles the `playwright` npm package; first run downloads real browser binaries (tens of MB), which is why this defaults off rather than because of any license concern.
skills.requires_tool: Node.js (already required) + Playwright browser binaries, downloaded on first run
skills.details: Disk-based Playwright QA scan for a running site -- screenshots, console errors, and broken-link checks in one report.

skills.name: Obsidian CLI
skills.description: Reads and writes notes in Obsidian
skills.author: Steph Ango (@kepano)
skills.note: Vendored byte-identical to upstream (diff against raw.githubusercontent.com/kepano/obsidian-skills/main/skills/obsidian-cli/SKILL.md is empty). Needs Obsidian actually running, not just installed, to do anything -- same detect precondition as the other three, no stronger check implemented for the running-vs-installed distinction.
skills.details: Reads, creates, and searches notes in a running Obsidian instance from the command line.

skills.name: Obsidian Markdown
skills.description: Writes notes the way Obsidian expects
skills.author: Steph Ango (@kepano)
skills.note: Vendored byte-identical to upstream (diff against raw.githubusercontent.com/kepano/obsidian-skills/main/skills/obsidian-markdown/SKILL.md is empty).
skills.details: Writes valid Obsidian-flavored markdown -- wikilinks, embeds, callouts, and frontmatter properties.

skills.name: Obsidian Bases
skills.description: Builds live tables from your notes
skills.author: Steph Ango (@kepano)
skills.note: Near-identical to upstream (497 vs 499 lines) -- a couple of filter-example lines differ (simplified vs. upstream's fuller example), same tool and scope.
skills.details: Creates and edits Obsidian .base files -- database-like table/card/list views over your notes.

skills.name: JSON Canvas
skills.description: Builds mind maps and flowcharts as notes
skills.author: Steph Ango (@kepano)
skills.note: Vendored byte-identical to upstream (diff against raw.githubusercontent.com/kepano/obsidian-skills/main/skills/json-canvas/SKILL.md is empty).
skills.details: Creates and edits .canvas files -- nodes, edges, and groups for mind maps and flowcharts in Obsidian.

skills.name: Voice
skills.description: Talk to it, and hear it answer
skills.author: jarvis-os project
skills.details: Speech in and speech out. Transcribes voice notes with ElevenLabs Scribe and falls back to whisper running locally on your own machine; speaks replies with ElevenLabs text-to-speech. Without a key the transcription half still works offline.
